change_policy: Joint action-input-delay calibration is evaluation-only. Training networks and checkpoints are unchanged; existing contracts v2-v7 remain frozen.

action_timing.elapsed_time_definition: absolute milliseconds since decision onset; never normalized by decision-window length
action_timing.evidence: raw top1 ActionNet logit - raw top2 ActionNet logit; algebraically log(p1/p2)
action_timing.action_input_delay: one nonnegative global fitted D shared by every T and Preview condition
action_timing.threshold_crossing_effect: an accepted proposal schedules its input D ms after its query
action_timing.deadline_rule: the most recent accepted proposal whose input arrives no later than the deadline is executed
action_timing.recurrent_state: all within-decision queries use pre-decision hidden; final query candidate commits once at the decision boundary

calibration.family_selection: calibration objective only; exponential must improve over linear by more than 5 percent
calibration.validation_role: held-out confirmation only; never parameter or family selection
calibration.offline_status: exact replay of commitment and delay decisions on logged query trajectories; not an exact counterfactual environment rollout after actions diverge

proposal_semantics.latest: latest accepted proposal arriving no later than deadline
proposal_semantics.forced_stay: no accepted proposal input arrives by deadline
proposal_semantics.canonical_latency: first arrival time at which the eventual final selected action became current
proposal_semantics.canonical_revision: first selected action differs from final selected action among non-timeout decisions
proposal_semantics.temporal_change: every change of current selected action is counted

policy_sampling.action_policy: deterministic top1 action after logit-margin commitment

stay.forced: no accepted proposal arrival by deadline; execute STAY
stay.intentional: STAY is the latest accepted action arriving by deadline
